messages:
maya: Quick sync — we've got multiple asks from enterprise pilots about routing guardrails for launch. Need a concise launch-criteria checklist that balances tenant isolation, multi-region routing, cost controls, and safe rollback. Can someone own final checklist by EOD? @alex @sam

alex: I can own the checklist. Top-line items: SLA tiers (gold/silver/beta), fallback ordering (model_variant -> region -> capacity), model compatibility matrix, evacuation playbook. I'll draft a first pass.

sam: +1. Ops items: monitoring hooks, autoscale burn-rate tests, and a cost-cap kill-switch. Also we need smoke runs of representative prompt sets to detect regressions.

lia: Security/ops note: add data residency gating per region, KMS & audit log verification for private deployments, and a circuit-breaker for cross-region spillover.

maya: Draft criteria pasted below — keep it terse so sales/legal can consume. Will iterate based on comments.

maya: ```yaml
launch_criteria:
  - SLA_tiers: [gold, silver, beta]
  - regional_affinity: preferred, fallback
  - isolation_modes: [shared, dedicated, quarantine]
  - failover_policy: [model_variant, region, capacity_tier]
  - quality_gate: prompt_set_pass >= 95%
  - monitoring: [token_cost, p50_latency, p99_latency, correctness_alerts]
  - rollback: canary + immediate-fallback-to-safe-variant
  - ops_controls: cost_cap_kill_switch, autoscale_burn_rate_thresholds
  - security_checks: KMS_integrated, audit_logs_enabled
```

alex: I'll add owners and test validations to that doc: eng-runtime -> alex, product -> maya, ops -> sam, security -> lia. Also add a small model-compat table mapping quantization variants to supported runtimes.

sam: Ops follow-up: validate burst capacity > expected peak for pilot customers, and include a runbook step: "evacuate-tenant -> drain-kv-cache -> spin-up-local-variant".

lia: Legal/security follow-up: flag jurisdictions where regional_affinity must be enforced (EU, CA, APAC sensitive accounts). We'll need privacy review for any cross-region fallback.

maya: Can @sales review customer-facing phrasing of the guardrails? We need to ensure we don't overpromise latency SLAs on beta. Also looping in @legal for residency wording.

deploy-bot: New PR created: git.redwood/infra/policies/launch-guardrails.md (diff 7)

alex: I'll open an RFC PR with owners and a lightweight checklist template and tag the pilot customers in the communication draft.

maya: Thanks all — target: finalize checklist tomorrow morning and publish a short one-pager for sales + pilot customers. If no objections, I'll mark as agreed and start the comms plan. :thumbsup:
